title: CoNP-completeness of binary directed chip-firing reachability
accepted_scope: Polynomial-time many-one NONHALTING≤m REACHABLE establishes coNP-hardness, and prior coNP membership yields coNP-completeness for loopless strongly connected binary-adjacency directed multigraphs with nonnegative binary initial/target configurations.
limitations: No directed hardness target gap asserted: nonnegative subclass suffices even though broader source language admits signed configurations. No simple/unary-adjacency hardness claimed. Distinct earlier PH-collapse result credited; source and target complexity encoding must be independently verified.
